name: Advance Your Skills as an IT Help Desk Specialist
description: Eleven-course learning path from LinkedIn Learning covering Windows 10 core services configuration, management and maintenance, advanced troubleshooting, PC hardware, IT service desk customer service, email and phone communication, problem-solving, and escalation handling. Completed all 11 courses (18 hours) to advance IT help desk skills.

criteria.narrative: Completed all eleven courses in the Advance Your Skills as an IT Help Desk Specialist learning path on LinkedIn Learning: Windows 10: Configure and Support Core Services, Windows 10: Manage and Maintain Windows 10, Windows 10 for IT Support: Advanced Troubleshooting, Learning PC Maintenance and Performance, Computer Components and Peripherals for IT Technicians, IT Service Desk: Customer Service Fundamentals, Writing Customer Service Emails, Phone-Based Customer Service, Customer Service: Problem-Solving and Troubleshooting, Working with Upset Customers, and Innovative Customer Service Techniques.
